At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 At Jacobs, we’re transforming intangible ideas into innovative solutions by designing the future—today. We challenge what is currently accepted to shape lasting solutions for tomorrow. If you’re looking for a rewarding career working alongside some of the industry’s most innovative professionals, Jacobs is where you belong.
   

  

 We are seeking an Entry\-Level Civil to join our team in Cobb County, GA. This is a full\-time, in\-office position (five days per week) with no hybrid or remote work option. In this role, you will contribute to municipal water, wastewater, and stormwater projects, supporting both design and field engineering activities while collaborating with multi\-disciplinary teams.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

 As part of our team, you will
   

  

* Work under the supervision and mentorship of experienced engineers
* Collaborate across multi\-disciplinary teams including engineers, CAD designers, project managers, and leadership
* Assist in the evaluation, design, coordination, and execution of water and wastewater infrastructure projects
* Prepare engineering deliverables such as
* Plans and specifications
* Engineering reports
* Cost estimates and quantity take\-offs
* Construction documents, sketches, models, and drawings
* Perform civil design tasks related to
* Site development and layout
* Stormwater and drainage systems
* Grading and erosion/sediment control
* Utilities and conveyance piping
* Facility/site layouts
* Assist with design using CADD tools such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and MicroStation
* Support development of engineering calculations and technical details
* Observe and document field and construction activities related to water, sewer pipelines, and stormwater conveyance projects (as needed)


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

* Strong analytical, technical problem\-solving, and organizational skills
* Effective verbal and written communication
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work both independently and in teams

title: Research Engineer (Member of Technical Staff) at Anthrogen
description_preview:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Research Engineer (Member of Technical Staff)
   

  

**Salary**
 Not Disclosed
   

  

**Company Description**
 Anthrogen.com is a San Francisco\-based startup at the intersection of AI and biology, building frontier models to accelerate scientific discovery and interpret complex biological systems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join Anthrogen.com as a Research Engineer to bridge the gap between biological data and machine learning. You will focus on the engineering challenges of pre\-training, inference, and model interpretability. This role is designed for exceptionally bright engineers who want to apply a research\-focused lens to complex technical problems in the biotech space.
   

  

**Location**
 San Francisco, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Work at the intersection of biology and AI with a team of elite researchers and engineers in the heart of San Francisco.
* Engage in high\-impact work involving the pre\-training and interpretation of frontier models that push the boundaries of current scientific capabilities.
* Join a high\-talent environment where you will collaborate directly with founders and top\-tier graduates from world\-renowned institutions like MIT and Caltech.


**What You Will Do**
* Design and implement scalable systems for pre\-training large\-scale models and optimizing inference performance for complex biological datasets.
* Develop sophisticated tools and methodologies for model interpretability to better understand and guide the learning process of frontier AI.
* Collaborate closely with the research team to translate theoretical advancements into robust, production\-ready engineering solutions.


**The ideal candidate**
* Holds a degree in Computer Science from a top\-tier program (e.g., MIT, Caltech), with an ideal background or double major in Biology.
* Possesses 1\-2 years of professional experience working in a frontier research lab or a high\-growth, research\-focused startup environment.
* Demonstrates exceptional technical proficiency in machine learning frameworks and a deep understanding of model architecture, training, and deployment.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.
